_comment: Deploy targets — one row per (tenant × stage). Each row maps to a GitHub Environment named `<tenant>-<stage>` (repo → Settings → Environments) that holds THAT stack's deploy vars (DEPLOY_PROJECT, ARTIFACT_REGISTRY, GCP_REGION, GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER, GCP_CI_SERVICE_ACCOUNT, NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APP_ID, NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_SERVER_CONTAINER_URL). The deploy workflow reads NO tenant/stage-specific value itself — it fans out over these rows. Add a target = add a row here, add infra/tenants/<tenant>/env/<stage>.tfvars, and create the Environment. No workflow edit.
_trigger: trigger controls WHEN a target auto-deploys (trunk-based promotion): 'push' = deploys on push to its `branch` (default 'main') — the integration stage, typically sbx. 'tag' = deploys only when the promotion tag deploy/<tenant>/<stage>/<version> is pushed (e.g. deploy/noise/prod/v1.4.0) — use for uat/prod. 'manual' = workflow_dispatch only. ANY target can also be deployed on demand via workflow_dispatch. Gating is ORTHOGONAL: set required reviewers on a prod/uat GitHub Environment and its run pauses for approval regardless of trigger.
_branch: Optional per-'push'-target branch (default 'main'). If you set a non-main branch, also add it to `on.push.branches` in deploy.yml. Prefer tag promotion over long-lived per-stage branches.
_stages: Stages live today: sbx (noise, csa). Planned: dev, uat, prod — add each as a new row (trigger 'tag' for uat/prod) + Environment + infra/tenants/<tenant>/env/<stage>.tfvars when its GCP project is provisioned. Example prod row: { "tenant": "noise", "stage": "prod", "trigger": "tag" }.
